description: A compact fold-out leather organizer that keeps necklaces separated, protects rings and earrings, and packs flat for travel.
origin: Starting model built by Codex from the Mission 1 concept images (front, side, back and open views) using editable parametric parts. The browser does not reconstruct 3D from images automatically.

hotspots.name: Spine
hotspots.description: Flexible spine folds the organizer flat for packing.

hotspots.name: Necklace bar
hotspots.description: Necklace bar with individual hooks: each chain hangs separately so it cannot tangle.

hotspots.name: Clear necklace pockets
hotspots.description: Clear vinyl pockets keep long necklaces apart and visible.

hotspots.name: Earring pad
hotspots.description: Padded earring panel holds studs and hoops in matched pairs.

hotspots.name: Ring roll
hotspots.description: Velvet ring roll: rings slide on and stay put.

hotspots.name: Zip storage page
hotspots.description: Separate zip storage page with room for bulky or odd-sized pieces.

hotspots.name: Snap closure
hotspots.description: Enlarged, reinforced snap closure (25% larger) to be tested through repeated use, because faulty snaps were the top defect in 80 Amazon reviews.
